title: Stage the WSL editor binary and assets for capture runs
body: After cmake --build build/wsl --target vixen_editor succeeded, the capture launcher still required manual copying of build/wsl/binaries/vixen_editor and its assets into VIXEN/binaries because the CMake target does not mirror the executable into the source runtime directory. Add a target or launcher that stages the matching executable and assets. The staged app then ran its capture script successfully.

title: Share one capture directory between editor apps and CTest
body: The editor process wrote captures under VIXEN/temp while CTest ran from build/wsl/libraries/RenderGraph/tests and looked in its relative default. The capture tests stayed red until I set VIXEN_EDITOR_CAPTURE_DIR=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/headless/VIXEN/temp; HUD capture similarly needed VIXEN_HUD_CAPTURE_DIR set to that directory. Provide one generated absolute capture path to both producers and test readers.

title: Preserve WSL loader libraries in the GPU capture launcher
body: The attempted GPU launch with LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib/wsl/lib replaced the login profile value /home/liory/.local/lib and failed loading libxcb-keysyms.so.1. Running under bash -lc while preserving the profile library path succeeded. Make the canonical Dozen launcher augment the WSL path without dropping profile libraries.

title: Provide an invariant globalization mode for the pinned .NET codegen tool
body: The queued target command cd build/wsl/codegen && /home/liory/.dotnet/dotnet build <CodegenTool.csproj> -c Release -nodeReuse:false failed before the generator started because the installed dotnet runtime could not find ICU. Setting DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1 made dotnet --info and the queued codegen checks run. Have the supported launcher supply this mode on WSL installations without ICU.

title: Resolve CTest suite-list paths before changing test directory
body: The queued invocation ctest --test-dir build/wsl --output-on-failure --tests-from-file build/wsl/rendergraph-svo-tests.txt failed before tests because --test-dir changed the list lookup directory. Passing the absolute path /home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/headless/build/wsl/rendergraph-svo-tests.txt succeeded. The suite helper should resolve its list argument before invoking CTest.

title: Allow a lane-local VIXEN provider override without editing the committed pin
body: KFR tools/vixen-root.sh validates VIXEN_ROOT against the SHA in toolchain/providers/vixen.pin, so the requested smoke against a different lane tip requires a temporary source overlay with a rewritten pin. Add a supported ephemeral provider SHA override or pin-overlay option; keep the committed provider pin unchanged for controller landing.

title: Keep runtime cache writes out of the tracked global manifest
body: Launching the editor capture process emptied the tracked VIXEN/cache/global/manifest.txt; I had to restore it with git checkout -- VIXEN/cache/global/manifest.txt after the baseline proof. Store runtime cache state under ignored output or make the generated manifest non-mutating during app runs.

title: Reuse provisioned Vulkan SDKs across KFR scratch builds
body: The queued configure command cmake -S .tmp/headless-source -B .tmp/headless-build downloaded a 320 MB LunarG SDK into the fresh consumer build cache. KFR currently makes VIXEN_VULKAN_CACHE_DIR build-local, even though the engine worktree already had the same SDK version. Provide a supported shared cache path so lane-local provider builds can reuse the provisioned SDK.

title: Reuse staged X11 development packages across KFR build trees
body: The same queued KFR configure reported X11 development files missing and provisioned them into .tmp/headless-build/windowing. This consumer path keeps the windowed renderer available while the requested smoke runs headless, but each scratch build has an empty windowing cache. Let KFR builds point at a reusable provider windowing cache.

title: Avoid refetching the kernel pin for scratch source overlays
body: Configuring the isolated KFR source overlay ran tools/kernel-root.sh --ensure, fetched the Yeroket main ref, and materialized the pinned b50d40f5 worktree under the overlay .tmp directory. Reuse a configured provider cache across source overlays or accept an explicit exact-pin YEROKET_ROOT so this scratch build does not provision the same provider again.

title: Build CodeGraph indexes for disposable worktrees
body: The required codegraph explore query had no index in the clean VIXEN and KFR worktrees, so source measurement fell back to rg after the unavailable-index response. Add a worktree initialization path that builds or shares the index before codegraph queries.
